profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer & Architect
profile.summary: Experienced software architect and developer with a deep understanding of the full stack. My primary platform is Java, but I've also been spending a lot of time with JavaScript, Python, PHP, Go, and Rust. I'm passionate about building cloud-native applications and modernizing legacy systems. I also love trying new technologies and adding them to my toolbox.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
As the software architect and team lead for a very small development team, I provided technical oversight and direction for all software developed within Cyberscout, along with mentoring for the team. I ensured that business requirements were met and clearly translated to technical requirements, while considering the needs and strategic direction of the entire enterprise. Due to the nature of Cyberscout's business, I also helped maintain application security throughout the development and operational lifecycle.

Achievements:
* Modernized Cyberscout's enterprise architecture, development processes, languages, frameworks, and tools
* Researched, prototyped, designed, and guided an SSO implementation for our customer-facing platforms, first via SAML for cross-enterprise integration, then via OIDC for cross-product integration
* Launched a couple of open source projects to encompass some vendor/framework integrations that we needed within our production services

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
* Lead development team in support of business-critical applications
* Evaluate new technologies and define technical direction for development organization
* Perform code reviews and technical mentoring to team
* Document and communicate development standards and procedures
* Initiated, directed, and coordinated Continuous Integration efforts
* Administer test and production Linux systems, including PostgreSQL database, Apache web servers, and Glassfish application servers

Accomplishments:
* Created first consumer-facing application for enrolling customers in credit monitoring product
* Built standardized Linux configurations for hosting Java EE applications in both test and production
* Led the transition to Maven for builds, including restructuring of the code base to facilitate reusable libraries, hosted in a Nexus artifact repository
* Led the implementation of Continuous Integration with Jenkins and Maven

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
* Designed and built retiree benefit disbursement system, which involved complicated business rules and integration with financial institution. Application built with Java, Spring, Hibernate, and JSF and integrated with a larger suite of back office applications.
* Helped design and implement a public website redesign using Java, Spring, Spring MVC, and iBatis. Used LiquiBase for database change management, and Canoo for end-to-end site testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Maintained a custom Loan Origination application built using EJB 2, JSP, and the Workpoint BPM engine.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented a variety of solutions for the Tenet Patient Financial Services division. Software was built in Java, running on the IBM iSeries. Also integrated a Syntellect IVR system with the iSeries and custom Java applications.

Led the effort to modernize development processes. Introduced CVS for version control, installed it on an iSeries Linux partition, and handled the administration and maintenance of it. Also installed Bugzilla and rolled it out to the development organization.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced The Eye Explorer, an application used for Retail analytics and planning. Desktop application was built in Java/Swing, and used a spreadsheet-like interface. Implemented complex business logic, such as formulas and integration with iSeries-based back-office software.

Assisted with the transition from IBM's Visual Age to Eclipse as the team's development environment.  This also necessitated moving from a "version tracking" scheme to a true version control system. Installed CVS for this purpose, and helped administer it. Installed and configured Anthill, an early Continuous Integration system, based on Ant.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Built film post-processing and digital encoding pipeline using Java Servlets and JSPs.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Implemented catalog and shopping cart solutions using a server-side JavaScript platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Built user interfaces in PowerBuilder and Visual Basic 6 to support the DOT and Continental Airlines.
